header: MUI v9 → Wireframe DSL — Property Support Matrix

rows.col1: Generated against Material UI v9.0.1 (mui.com/material-ui/all-components). Support tiers reflect the Wireframe DSL spec v0.1.
Meaning
MUI v9 component (or DSL-specific element such as Img / Spacer).
MUI docs grouping (Inputs, Data display→Content, Feedback, Surfaces, Navigation, Layout, Utils).
Which milestone the COMPONENT itself enters the DSL: v0.1 (prototype), v1.0 (broad-coverage), or never (not in the DSL vocabulary, e.g. Tooltip, Popover, Modal, MUI X).
The MUI prop name. Parenthesised names like (width) or (filler) are DSL-side concepts, not literal MUI props.
Prop type or enum value set.
Default value in MUI v9.
Per-PROPERTY milestone WITHIN a supported component: v0.1 / v1.0 / never (prop intentionally dropped from a component that IS in the DSL). For 'never' components every property reads n/a.
Whether the property may be written without key= on that component (DSL §3.2.2). 'yes' = keyless-allowed.
The keyed DSL prop the value resolves to (or '(indentation)' for containment).
Rationale / caveat.
Definition
Required in the prototype. Matches the ✓ components and keyless rules in spec §5.
Targeted for broad MUI coverage milestone. Useful but not needed to wireframe.
Out of scope by design: theming (sx/style/color/elevation), spacing minutiae, transient overlays (Tooltip/Popover/Snackbar timing), behavior-only props, and low-level utils.
From spec §3.2.2 (enforced at component-definition time)
At most ONE string-literal keyless property per component (the text/label).
Numbers may not be keyless, except sizing tokens (width/height/flex).
An enum value may not be keyless if it duplicates a boolean property's key.
An enum value may not be keyless if it appears in more than one enum property.
On v0.1 components the keyless set is ≤1 literal (label) + ≤1 enum (variant) + sizing, which never collide, so order is free.
Notes reflected in the matrix
'column' / 'column-reverse' removed from direction in v9; direction is row-only.
Deprecated CardHeader props removed in v9.
Deprecated ListItem/ListItemText props and deprecated input props/classes removed.
NumberField (Base UI powered) and Menubar added in v9 — both mapped to v1.0 here.
nativeButton prop added in v9 (render concern; never).
Property of a component whose Component tier is 'never' — the whole component is out, so per-property support does not apply.
